name: The Horde Needs More Copper Bars!

tooltip: "Seek out an Horde Commendation Officer to exchange signets for recognition."

statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details: Back so soon? You'll be a real miner in no time champion. So, you already know the drill; I need you to go out, mine up a mess of copper ore, smelt it into bars and bring it back to me here. I know that's something you're capable of, the question is, are you willing?
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 copper bars to Miner Cromwell in Durotar.
narrative.offerRewardText: You've proven yourself to me yet again, Champion. I will see to it that this copper is used in due time. For now though, I need to get these copper bars onto the pallet and tallied. If you still feel inclined, I could probably use your help in gathering even more copper bars.
